name: Katahira Ayumu
source:
He is a first-year student at Seishin Academy and a member of the art club. He fell in love at first sight with [url=/c121752]Sakuraba Mayu[/url], his senior in the art club. But he was too shy to confess his feelings. However, his situation changes when he meets [url=/c133970]Tanaka[/url].......
